validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <transition cond="x && y" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: malformed XML: unterminated XML reference in attribute value
notes: SCXML documents must be well-formed XML 1.0 with namespaces; no later validation runs until parsing succeeds
diagnostics.help: escape a literal `&` as `&` (for example `cond="a && b"`), or put the expression in a CDATA section inside `<script>`
